# Receipt fixture boundary

These are synthetic fixtures generated by `node scripts/create-receipt-fixtures.mjs`. They contain no personal data. They do **not** establish support for any supermarket, language, OCR system, or AI model.

| File | Content | Verified use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| synthetic-text.pdf | Embedded text with rice multipack, weighted apples, milk, discount, and an ambiguous item | PDF structural validation, upload/hash identity and storage tests |
| synthetic-image-only.pdf | One stretched blank image, no embedded grocery text | Valid image-only PDF input; no extraction accuracy claim |
| proposal.json | Hand-authored expected example proposal, including unresolved quantity | Contract validation only; never returned by production parsing |

A user supplied one German REWE eBon on 2026-10-25. The original stays outside Git; payment, loyalty, store and fiscal identifiers are not committed. Both pages have embedded text, and a private local extraction check preserved all 33 priced source labels. This measures text preservation, not product interpretation or model accuracy. Automatic parsing remains disabled. Before enabling it, collect sanitized digital and scanned examples, choose/evaluate an embedded-text parser and a model, test the shared two-call/time budget and stale-attempt leases, and measure line coverage and field accuracy. The image-only fixture is not an OCR quality benchmark. PDFs requiring an opening password are rejected. Owner-protected PDFs that open without a password (such as this sample, which permits copying) are accepted.

## REWE-style regression fixtures

`rewe-style-fictional.pdf` is a new fictional two-page PDF built by `scripts/create-rewe-fixture.mjs`. It retains representative layout patterns but changes purchase details and omits all real identifiers. `rewe-style-expected.json` is manually annotated expected review evidence, not model output. It covers weighted bananas/chestnuts, repeated item counts, missing milk carton size, explicit bottle size, deposits, a discount and ambiguous/non-food labels. It never assumes a package size or unknown purchase count.

`rewe-style-readable-protected.pdf` reproduces the password-free, owner-protected behavior. `password-required.pdf` requires the test-only opening password `fixture-opening-password` and must be rejected by the app. Regenerate these with `python3 scripts/create-protected-fixtures.py` using pypdf 6.10.0; ordinary tests use the committed fictional files and do not require Python. The owner password is test data, not a credential.

The initial unpdf 1.9.1/PDF.js 6.4.299 extractor preserves all expected labels and quantity evidence. Sparse, garbled, partly empty and oversized extracted text is routed to `vision_required`; vision/model execution is not implemented. The blank image fixture only proves no-text routing. A single digital REWE sample does not establish scanned receipt support, universal German parsing, or complete receipt acceptance.
